title: 2026 Week 6 revised conference strength hierarchy with updated passing/rushing offensive unit models
method: PO = 45% PPA + 45% passing success + 10% explosiveness percentiles, plus opponent passing-defense premium and conference adjustment. RO = six equally weighted rush metric percentiles, plus opponent rushing-defense premium and same conference adjustment. PD and RD remain prior aggressive unit baseline plus conference factor delta (Big Ten now -2). Offensive/Defensive Strength each equal the average of their two matching unit ratings. Overall Strength derived as sensitivity update of prior overall score by 55% of average difference in unit composites; not a ground-up recomputation.
limitations: Defensive unit metrics not reconstructed or independently recalibrated; only conference delta applied.
PO and RO research percentages and PD/RD older scale may not be directly comparable; provisional composite until unit scales validated.
